stories.headline: AMD's Lisa Su says AMD will 'substantially increase' chip supply in 2027, needs more wafer capacity

key_facts.fact: On October 6, 2026, AMD CEO Lisa Su told reporters in Taipei that AMD will 'substantially increase' its chip supply in 2027 as it races to meet AI demand.
key_facts.excerpt: "We've been able to increase our supply as we've gone through 2026, and we're going to substantially increase our supply in 2027," Su told reporters in Taipei.

key_facts.fact: Su said AMD needs more advanced wafer capacity and has extended its planning horizon with partners from one-to-two years to three-to-five years.
key_facts.excerpt: Su said strong demand for computing capacity had prompted AMD to extend its planning horizon with partners from one or two years to three to five. ... Meeting computing demand over the next several years would require additional advanced wafer capacity, she said.

key_facts.fact: Su said AMD will raise its investment in Taiwan's supply chain above the $10 billion it announced in May, without giving a new figure.
key_facts.excerpt: Su said the US$10 billion investment announced in May was progressing as planned. ... "We're increasing that number going forward because our demand has continued to go up"

key_facts.fact: Su met Foxconn and was due to meet TSMC; asked about a potential TSMC investment in Texas she did not answer directly.
key_facts.excerpt: She has met Foxconn and is due to meet TSMC as part of discussions with local partners. Asked whether TSMC had discussed a potential investment in Texas with AMD, Su did not answer directly

key_facts.fact: On her third Taiwan trip of the year, Su also met Acer, Asus and Quanta; AMD's Q2 data center revenue was $6.7 billion, up 107% year over year.
key_facts.excerpt: Su, on her third trip to Taiwan this year ... had held meetings with Acer, Asus, Foxconn, and Quanta ... The company's second-quarter data center revenue reached $6.7 billion, up 107% year over year

key_facts.fact: Su said AMD will keep outsourcing manufacturing rather than invest in its own fab.
key_facts.excerpt: When asked whether AMD would consider investing in a fab, Su said AMD is going to keep its existing business model of outsourcing its chip manufacturing.

stories.headline: Google signs 3.6 GW power deal with Constellation, funding 890 MW of nuclear uprates in PJM

key_facts.fact: On October 6, 2026, Google and Constellation Energy announced a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 MW of new nuclear capacity from upgrades at 11 Constellation-owned reactors in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey.
key_facts.excerpt: The 20-year power purchase agreement will enable investments in new equipment and technology at 11 Constellation-owned nuclear units in Illinois, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey

key_facts.fact: The companies also signed a 15-year energy supply agreement for an additional 2,700 MW in PJM, bringing the total to about 3.6 GW.
key_facts.excerpt: the companies entered into a 15-year energy supply agreement for an additional 2,700 MWs in PJM's fleet.

key_facts.fact: The deal represents more than $4.3 billion of new investment by Constellation, with the first uprate expected by 2028.
key_facts.excerpt: represents more than $4.3 billion of new investment by Constellation ... with the first uprate expected to be delivered by 2028.

key_facts.fact: The companies framed the deal as a direct response to grid operator PJM's 'Bring Your Own Power' proposal for data center customers.
key_facts.excerpt: The agreement offers a direct response to PJM's "Bring Your Own Power" proposal

key_facts.fact: Google says the deal brings the new nuclear capacity it has enabled from uprates and restarts to over 1.5 GW, and includes deploying Gemini Enterprise to optimize Constellation's plant operations.
key_facts.excerpt: Our new agreement with Constellation Energy brings the total new nuclear capacity we've enabled for the U.S. energy system from uprates and restarts to over 1.5 GW. ... deploy Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise to help Constellation optimize their nuclear plant operations.

key_facts.fact: The WSJ called it the largest deal yet to squeeze more power out of existing reactors; Constellation shares rose about 5% premarket.
key_facts.excerpt: The deal, which calls for Constellation to invest more than $4.3 billion in the plants, is the largest yet to squeeze more power out of existing reactors, known as an "uprate."

key_facts.fact: Constellation shares traded about 5% higher in premarket trading after the announcement.
key_facts.excerpt: Constellation Energy shares are trading about 5% higher in pre-market on Tuesday after the company announced a 20-year power purchase agreement with Google

stories.headline: Inference-chip startup Etched fields funding offers at $40B-$50B, weeks after $21B round

key_facts.fact: TechCrunch reported on October 5, 2026 that Etched is reviewing incoming funding bids ranging from $40 billion from top-tier investors to $50 billion from lesser-known backers.
key_facts.excerpt: Etched is reviewing incoming bids that range from $40 billion from top-tier investors to $50 billion from lesser-known backers, one person said.

key_facts.fact: Etched raised $700 million at a $21 billion valuation in September, after a $300 million Sequoia-led round at $10.3 billion in July.
key_facts.excerpt: The startup announced a $300 million round at a $10.3 billion led by Sequoia in July. It announced the $700 million round at a $21 billion valuation in September.

key_facts.fact: The talks are early and Etched declined to comment; a round the size of the last one could give it up to 3.5 years of runway.
key_facts.excerpt: These fundraising talks are early, so terms of any deal, should one happen, may change. Etched declined to comment. ... could give Etched a cushion of as much as 3.5 years of runway.

key_facts.fact: Etched builds full AI hardware systems around its own inference chips and claims they process tokens faster and cheaper than Nvidia's; Jane Street is a customer.
key_facts.excerpt: The company claims its chips can process more tokens faster and at a lower cost than Nvidia's. That's the reason its processors have been so attractive to Jane Street

key_facts.fact: Jane Street led Etched's latest $700 million round and has taken delivery of an early system.
key_facts.excerpt: Quant trading firm Jane Street led Etched's most recent $700 million funding round and has already taken delivery of an early system.

stories.headline: Singapore data-center operator DayOne files for Nasdaq IPO; H1 revenue more than triples to $512M

key_facts.fact: On October 5, 2026, DayOne Data Centers filed an F-1 with the SEC for a US IPO of American depositary shares, applying to list on Nasdaq under the ticker 'DODC'.
key_facts.excerpt: DayOne ... today announced that it has filed a registration statement on Form F-1 ... DayOne has applied to list the ADSs on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol "DODC".

key_facts.fact: Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities and Citigroup are underwriters; share count and price range were not set.
key_facts.excerpt: Morgan Stanley, J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, and Citigroup will act as underwriters of the IPO. The number of ADSs to be offered and the price range for the proposed offering have not yet been determined.

key_facts.fact: The filing shows first-half 2026 revenue of $512.0 million versus $151.5 million a year earlier, and a $77.2 million net loss.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenue was $512.0 million in the six months ended June 30, 2026, against $151.5 million a year earlier. The company still lost $77.2 million in that period

key_facts.fact: One customer, a global technology company with a short-form video platform, accounted for 69.2% of H1 revenue, and Malaysia for 87.0%.
key_facts.excerpt: The largest customer, a global technology company with a short-form video platform, accounted for 69.2% of first-half 2026 revenue. Malaysia accounted for 87.0%.

key_facts.fact: Reuters reported in February that DayOne aimed to raise up to $5 billion at a potential $20 billion valuation; the company began as a subsidiary of Shanghai-based GDS Holdings and raised $4.5 billion in a June Series C.
key_facts.excerpt: Reuters reported in February that the company was aiming to raise as much as US$5 billion at a potential valuation of US$20 billion. ... began as a subsidiary of Shanghai-based GDS Holdings. ... raising US$4.5 billion

key_facts.fact: DayOne operates data centers in ten markets in Asia Pacific and Europe, including Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Japan, Hong Kong, Finland and Spain.
key_facts.excerpt: Founded in 2022, DayOne operates data centers across ten markets in Asia Pacific and Europe, including Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Japan, Hong Kong SAR, Finland, and Spain.

stories.headline: Seagate and Toshiba reportedly vie for TDK's hard-drive head unit; Toshiba disputes report

key_facts.fact: Bloomberg reported on October 6, 2026 that Seagate and Toshiba are competing to buy TDK's hard-disk-drive magnetic-heads business, in a deal that could be worth as much as several billion dollars.
key_facts.excerpt: Seagate Technology Holdings Plc and Toshiba Corp. are locked in a contest for TDK Corp.'s magnetic-heads business for hard-disk drives ... The acquisition is expected to be worth as much as several billion dollars

key_facts.fact: According to the report, Toshiba opened talks in the spring and Seagate followed with a higher offer in the summer.
key_facts.excerpt: Toshiba initiated talks with TDK in the spring, followed by a higher offer in the summer from Seagate, people familiar with the matter said.

key_facts.fact: TDK is the only independent maker of HDD recording heads and supplies Seagate, Toshiba and Western Digital; Toshiba relies on it entirely and needs its technology for HAMR drives.
key_facts.excerpt: TDK ... is the only independent supplier of magnetic recording heads ... supplies all three HDD giants ... Toshiba relies entirely on the Japanese supplier. Access to TDK's technology is also critical to Toshiba's plans to mass-produce ... HAMR drives

key_facts.fact: TrendForce projects 2026 HDD share at Western Digital 48%, Seagate 42% and Toshiba 10%; any deal would likely face antitrust scrutiny.
key_facts.excerpt: TrendForce projects Western Digital to hold a 48% share in 2026, followed by Seagate at 42%, while Toshiba trails at 10%. ... any transaction would also likely draw close antitrust scrutiny

key_facts.fact: TDK shares jumped as much as 7.3% in Tokyo trading on October 6.
key_facts.excerpt: TDK股價周二（6日）在東京盤中大漲7.3%

key_facts.fact: Toshiba and its main backer Japan Industrial Partners said the report was inconsistent with their understanding, and Toshiba denied any three-way supply talks with TDK and Seagate.
key_facts.excerpt: A Toshiba spokesperson called the report "inconsistent" with the company's understanding of the situation. Japan Industrial Partners, Toshiba's main backer, also disputed the report.

stories.headline: Ghost emerges from stealth with $11M a16z-led seed for a $3,499 computer built to run AI agents

key_facts.fact: On October 5, 2026, Ghost, founded by 19-year-old Zain Javaid, emerged from stealth with an $11 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz, with Abstract, Audacious Ventures, SV Angel and Nova participating.
key_facts.excerpt: Ghost, which announced Monday that it has emerged from stealth after a year of building, along with an $11 million seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz. Other investors in the round include Abstract, Audacious Ventures, SV Angel, and Nova.

key_facts.fact: Its first product, Core, is a $3,499 personal computer designed to continuously run AI agents, with a bundled Nvidia RTX Pro 4000 SFF Blackwell GPU.
key_facts.excerpt: Core includes an Nvidia RTX Pro 4000 SFF Blackwell GPU ... Core costs $3,499.

key_facts.fact: Pre-orders opened Monday, with shipping scheduled for the last week of October.
key_facts.excerpt: Pre-orders for the first batch open Monday, and shipping is scheduled for the last week of October.

key_facts.fact: SiliconANGLE reported the first batch has already sold out, and that source code, logic and model weights run on the device so it keeps working even if Ghost disappears.
key_facts.excerpt: Because all of the source code, logic and model weights run on the computer itself, it would continue functioning perfectly even if Ghost itself disappears. ... the first batch of devices, which has already sold out, cost $3,499 apiece.

stories.headline: SK hynix lifts Q4 fab construction spending with SK ecoplant 61.5% to 4.25 trillion won

key_facts.fact: SK hynix disclosed on October 6, 2026 that it will raise its estimated Q4 2026 construction transactions with affiliate SK ecoplant to 4.2462 trillion won.
key_facts.excerpt: SK hynix disclosed on the 6th that it will increase its estimated construction transaction amount with SK ecoplant in the fourth quarter of this year to KRW 4.2462 trillion.

key_facts.fact: The figure is 1.6176 trillion won (61.5%) above the 2.6286 trillion won disclosed in February.
key_facts.excerpt: This is KRW 1.6176 trillion (61.5%) more than the estimated transaction amount of KRW 2.6286 trillion disclosed last February.

key_facts.fact: Of the total, 4.0049 trillion won goes to building new semiconductor fabs.
key_facts.excerpt: Of the total transaction amount, KRW 4.0049 trillion will be spent on constructing new semiconductor factories.

key_facts.fact: SK hynix also switched construction payments from promissory notes to cash.
key_facts.excerpt: The board approved a higher Q4 2026 transaction value with SK ecoplant and shifted construction payments fully to cash.

key_facts.fact: SK hynix shares fell 2.1% to 1,803,000 won amid foreign selling, as Samsung narrows the HBM gap (Counterpoint: SK hynix 50% vs Samsung 33% HBM revenue share in Q2).
key_facts.excerpt: the stock shed 2.1% to close at 1,803,000.00 KRW ... Counterpoint Research puts SK Hynix's HBM revenue share at 50% in the second quarter of 2026, with its rival now at 33%.
